seasons.summary: The Tallawahs became the first CPL champions. Their bowlers held Guyana to 128 before Chris Gayle guided a controlled chase that ended with 15 balls remaining.

seasons.result: Barbados Tridents won by 8 runs (D/L method)
seasons.summary: Rain shortened Guyana's chase and produced the only weather-adjusted CPL final in this record. Barbados defended the revised target to collect the franchise's first title.

seasons.result: Trinidad & Tobago Red Steel won by 20 runs
seasons.summary: The Red Steel won their first championship on home soil. That title belongs to the same franchise that was renamed Trinbago Knight Riders before the 2016 season.
Jamaica produced one of the most decisive finals in league history. Guyana were dismissed for 93 and the Tallawahs needed fewer than 13 overs to secure their second trophy.

seasons.result: Trinbago Knight Riders won by 3 wickets
seasons.summary: TKR recovered from 90 for seven to win a tense chase. Kevon Cooper's unbeaten 29 from 14 balls delivered the franchise's second title and its first under the Knight Riders name.

seasons.result: Trinbago Knight Riders won by 8 wickets
seasons.summary: TKR became the first team to retain the CPL title. Colin Munro anchored the chase as the hosts overhauled 148 with eight wickets in hand.
Barbados ended Guyana's record 11-match winning run at the final hurdle. Jonathan Carter's unbeaten 50 helped set up a 27-run victory and the Tridents' second crown.

seasons.result: Trinbago Knight Riders won by 8 wickets
seasons.summary: TKR completed the CPL's only perfect championship season: 12 matches, 12 wins. Lendl Simmons and Darren Bravo carried the unbeaten side through the final chase.

seasons.result: St Kitts & Nevis Patriots won by 3 wickets off the final ball
seasons.summary: Dominic Drakes struck an unbeaten 48 from 24 balls as the Patriots reached 160 from the final delivery. It remains the franchise's first CPL championship.
Brandon King made an unbeaten 83 as Jamaica chased 162 in only 16.1 overs. The result gave the Tallawahs a third title from three final appearances.

seasons.result: Guyana Amazon Warriors won by 9 wickets
seasons.summary: After five previous final defeats, Guyana finally lifted the trophy. Imran Tahir's team dismissed TKR for 94 and completed the chase with nine wickets remaining.

seasons.result: Saint Lucia Kings won by 6 wickets
seasons.summary: Saint Lucia recovered from a difficult chase to win its first CPL title. Aaron Jones and Roston Chase turned the final late and denied defending champions Guyana.

seasons.result: Trinbago Knight Riders won by 3 wickets
seasons.summary: TKR chased 131 to reclaim the championship and move to five titles, the most in CPL history. Guyana finished runner-up for a seventh time.

seasons.result: Winner and runner-up to be decided
seasons.summary: The 2026 tournament is scheduled from 7 August to 20 September. This record will be updated after the final; no 2026 champion has been declared.

notes: The 2015 title won by Trinidad & Tobago Red Steel belongs to the franchise now known as Trinbago Knight Riders.
Barbados won in 2014 and 2019 as the Tridents. The same franchise competed as the Royals from 2021 to 2025 and restored the Tridents name for 2026.
The St Lucia Zouks, St Lucia Stars and Saint Lucia Kings are treated as one continuous franchise.
Jamaica Tallawahs and Jamaica Kingsmen are separate franchises. Tallawahs titles are not assigned to the Kingsmen, who enter the men's CPL in 2026.
methodology: Win percentage is wins divided by decided matches through the end of CPL 2025. No-results are excluded from the denominator. A Super Over result is counted as a win or loss. Franchise renames are combined only where the team has documented continuity; replacement or new franchises are kept separate.
